(223)༄༅/ /chos rje lo ras pa las brgyud pa'i dpal ldan smad 'thug bka' brgyud kyi khyad chos thub pa lnga'i gdams khrid chos sku rang shar ces bya ba bzhu

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (223)༄༅// chos rje lo ras pa las brgyud pa'i dpal ldan smad 'thug bka' brgyud kyi khyad chos thub pa lnga'i gdams khrid chos sku rang shar ces bya ba bzhugs so//

(224)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ dpal ldan 'brug pa bka' brgyud las chos rje lo ras pa las brgyud pa'i smad 'brug gi khyad chos thub pa lnga'i gdams khrid nyams su len pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gi khrid do// dang po la/ 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa zlog pa'i phyir mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ nges par 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi ba la bzlog thabs med/ shi nas gar 'gro cha med/ de la phan pa dam pa'i chos las gzhan med pa dang lnga'i sgo nas skyo shas dang nges 'byung bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i phyir rdor sems yi ge brgya'i bzlas bsgom/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams rtags thon par nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po gding thub/ yan lag gtum mo ras thub/ gsang spyod ri thub/ nad gdon 'khrugs thub/ gnyen po rkyen thub bo// dang po la gsum/ slob mas sems ngo btsal ba/ bla mas ngo sprad pa/ man ngag gi gtan (225)la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba/ chags sdang bde sdug la sogs pa'i rtsa ba sems su 'dug gam mi 'dug blta/ sna tshogs su rtog pa'i sems 'di gang na gnas/ gzugs dbyibs ji ltar 'dug kha dog ji ltar 'dug blta/ yang*/ mdun tu me chen bsgom pa la sems bsreg nas tshig gam mi tshig /chu chen la sbang nas bang ngam mi sbang*/ rnon po'i mtshon gyis bcad nas chod dam mi chod blta/ yang*/ dgra bsam la zhe sdang skye mkhan la brtag /gnyen bsam la gdung sems skye mkhan la brtag /nor rdzas bsam la 'dod pa skye mkhan la brtag nas sems tshol bas/ sems 'di 'dra zhes snyed na de sems yin min rtsad bcad du gzhug /ma snyed na med pa'i ngo bo la brtag /gnyis kas tshol mkhan gyi rtog pa la rtsad gcod du gzhug pas go ba dpe bltas sogs min pa'i thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems/ sems la dngos po gang du'ang ma grub pa la 'gags med cig 'char ba shes dgos so// gnyis pa ngo sprad pa la gsum/

dang po nyan (226)thos kyi gzigs mo ni/ shin tu dben pa'i gnas su phyin la/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun bca'/ khru gang tsam gyi mdun du dmigs rten shing bu'am rde'u la mig phab ste bltar gzhug /sems ma bsgrim par khong nas lhod la bzhag 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da lta ba'i shes pa gang la'ang mi mno mi bsam/ ngos bzung med pa'i ngang du bzhag /tshogs drug gi rtog pa gang la'ang chags sdang ched 'dzin dgag sgrub gang yang mi byed par sems ma bcos pa'i ngang du 'bol le shig ge lhod la bzhag /dang po thung thung la grangs mang ba dang*/ de nas yun je ring mthar nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'gro bar bslab/ gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i gzigs mo ni/ mig sna rtse la phab/ rig pa gzhan du mi 'phro bar 'bol le bzhag sems dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs/ dngos po rang bzhin bden par ma grub pa'i ngang du 'bol le/ tshogs drug gi snang ba gang shar thams cad rang stong*/ stong nyid tsam du mi bzung ba 'dzin med zhen bral ma bcos pa'i ngang du bzhag go /gsum pa rdo rje 'chang gi gzigs mo ni/ sna rtse'i thad kyi bar snang gi nam mkha' stong sang nge 'di la mig ma yengs par gtad/ sems mi mno mi bsam pa'i ngang la 'bol le shig ge bzhag /bltas pas mi mthong*/ bsam med brjod med gza' gtad bral ba'i ngang du zhog /ces ngo sprad/ sems tshol rnams la zhag re/ ngo sprod la tshig dang tha snyad nyung dus yud tsam rer bzhag la slar zhag bdun du bskyang gzhug /gsum pa man ngag gis gtan la dbab pa ni/ zhag bdun nas ngo 'phrod na/ sems skye med blo 'das/ dngos med spros bral/ gzhi med rtsa bral/ gsal stong zung 'jug la bsgom rgyu ci'ang med par mdo rgyud kyi lung sbyor dang bcas te bshad/ yum las/ sems 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar ba'i sangs (227)rgyas rnams kyis ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur bar gsungs pa dang*/

sems la sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*/ dgyes rdor las/ sgom med sgom pa po yang med/ ces sogs dang*/ grub thob rnams kyi gsung la brten nas stong nyid du yid ches par bya/ 'khor 'das sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ sngar sems dngos med du ma shes pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong*/ da shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams don sdug bsngal myong don med/ bltar med mthong med de nyid don dam pa'i bden pa mthong ba yin te/ sdud pa las/ gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing*// 'du shes mthong ba med la sems dpa' mi mthong zhing*// gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid mthong med pa// 'di ni chos mthong yin ces de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ zhes sogs gsung*/ gnas lugs kyi don de ngag tu smra ru med/ tshig tu brjod du med/ yid la bsam du med de/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so/ rang sems rtogs na sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa 'di ga yin pas 'di nyid rtogs pas chog ste/ rgyud brtag gnyis las/ 'jig rten khams ni gang du yang*// sangs rgyas gzhan du rnyed mi 'gyur// sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med/ ces sogs bka' bstan bcos kun nas mgrin gcig tu gsung*/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i gshis thog tu bzhag pas chog /rgyus cha rang la yod kyang bla mas ngo sprad pa de bzhin la me long bstan pa dang 'dra/ bsgom rgyu rdul tsam yang med pas rtogs (228)bya'i sgom bshig /sgom pa'i gnyen po bshigs/ bsgom pa'i 'bras bu blo zad chos zad la bshigs/ mi sgom pa'i bzhag thabs la drug /byas tshad 'khrul par 'dug pas byar med du bzhag /sgom tshad rtog par 'dug pas sgom med du bzhag

/brjod tshad stong nyid du 'dug pas brjod med du bzhag /dran tshad snang stong du 'dug pas rang grol du bzhag /'gyu tshad chos nyid du 'dug pas rgya yan du bzhag /ye nas lhun grub tu 'dug pas yin thog tu bzhag pa'o// mjug la gsum/ skyong tshul/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don no// dang po la gsum/ las dang po pa rnal 'byor chung ngu'i dus/ dben pa brten no// 'du 'dzi zhen pa bya ba thams cad bskyung*/ rtsol sgrub bskyed/ rtog pa dgag /skyes bdo ba dang rtsad gcod/ sgom skyes rung ma skyes rung 'bad la nyams su len/ rnal 'byor 'bring po'i dus/ sgom 'phro mi bcad/ tshe 'di'i dbang du mi btang*/ chos brgyad chags sdang bde sdug thams cad phra chod sbom chod la btang*/ thog brdzis dang ro snyoms la gnyen po'i dpung dang ma bral bar bya/ rnal 'byor chen po dus/ spang gnyen gnyis ka bor/ nyon mongs dang ye shes/ rnam rtog dang chos sku/ nyams su len bya len byed gang yang med pa'i dbu ma'i ngang du bzhag par bya'o// gnyis pa gegs bsal ba la'ang gsum/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gegs/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi gegs/ lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gegs rnams ngo shes par byas la bsal/ gsum pa bogs 'don pa ni/ lam mchog thub pa lnga bsten par bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa gtum mo ras thub la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ nges 'byung dang dad pas kun nas bslangs te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du bsgom/ gnyis (229)pa la gsum/ rtsa sbyong ba'i phyir stong ra/ drod skye ba'i phyir gtum mo// bogs 'don pa'i phyir de'i zhal gdams bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ lus 'di stong sang de/ yang phya le/ srab phyam me ba/ khong pa'i nang gi ljan ljin thams cad 'og sgo gnyis nas mar sang gi thon te phru ma phus btab pa lta bu/ rtsa gsum zo ba dpyad la btags pa lta bu ma 'byar bar bsgom/ gnyis pa gtum mo spyi khrid bsgom pa la gsum bca' ba lus kyi gnad/

'byung 'jug rlung gi gnad/ dmigs pa yul gyi gnad do// dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi chos lnga'am rnam snang chos bdun bca'/ gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi bum can bzung*/ gsum pa ni/ rang lus lhag pa'i lha'i rtsa dbu ma yar sna spyi bo'i haṃ la zug pa/ mar sna lte ba'i thad kar rag dung gi kha ltar yod pa/ g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gnyis yar sna sna bug dang*/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi nas yar log dbu ma'i nang du tshud par bsgom/ rtsa gsum 'dus mdor me a shad kyi rnam pa sor brgyad kha dog dmar po// rtse mo rno ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ dmar lhang lhang ba la dmigs pa gtad/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams thim pas sngar bas 'bum 'gyur gyis tsha bar bsgom/ des dbu ma'i nang thams cad dmar lam me ba/ tsha 'ur re/ sdig sgrib thams cad thul thul tshig par bsgom/ gsum pa/ zhal gdams bsgom pa la gsum/ bogs 'don pa/ brtan pa thob pa/ gegs sel bar byed pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum/ drod bde ba/ phyag chen gyi bogs 'don pa'o// dang po ni/ me'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rang lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma me'i sku can/ de'i thugs kar rang 'dra ba'i (230)me'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bo nas me'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma go zhu lubs su blugs pas phyi nang med pa me'i rang bzhin tu bsgom/ 'di dag gi skabs su bde drod kyi ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs zhes gsol 'debs drag tu bya/ sems rtse gcig tu bzung*/ gtum mo me'i 'khor lo ni/ lte ba'i rtsa gsum gyi phyogs bzhir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng na mkha' 'gro sde bzhi me'i rang bzhin tu bzhugs par/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan thams cad me'i rang bzhin/ rlung mnan pas rtsa nang du 'khor bar bsgom/ gtum mo rtsubs shing ma ni/ me'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i phyag gis rtsa ro rkyang gnyis la 'jus/

rlung mnan pas rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar bsgom/ gtum mo me drod kyi ye shes ni/ lte bar dbu ma'i nang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor me'i rang bzhin can gar stabs ling ling 'khrab cing 'dug par bsgom/ gtum mo me'i snying po ni/ rang lus lha skur bsgom pa'i ste ba'i thad po ba'i dkyil na thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du me 'u ru ru 'bar bar bsgom/ gtum mo bde stong ma ni/ srog rtsa'i nang na me'i rdo rje a ru ra'i snying po tsam zhig bsgom/ rlung me'i rdo rje rtsa sbub thams cad dkrugs par bsgom/ gtum mo me'i srog shing ni/ lto ba'i thad dkar nyi dkyil la raṃ las me'i sdong po khru gang sbom phra lag ngar tsam yal ga thams cad mer gyes pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad me lce 'chubs khyi li li 'bar bar bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ rlung gi gzhu la me yi mda'// byang sems haṃ gis 'ben la brdeg /zag med bdud rtsi'i bdag lus gang*// myur du ye shes 'char bar 'gyur// bde chen 'khor lo yang lnga bsam// sprul pa'i 'khor lo yum lnga bsam// snying gar 'dus te snyam par 'dug /zag med bde bas bdag lus gang*/ gsang ba'i (231)rdo rje'i sbubs su drangs// lte ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// pad+mar thim pas bde stong gis// thig le ye shes bcud kyis gang*// dngos sam kun spong yid kyis ni// zhes rab yid 'ong bcu drug yum/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i ye shes mchog /mi 'gyur zag med bde chen bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ dmigs pa a thung la gtad de gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nang du bzhag /rlung stong nyid kyi ngang du bzung*/ dran rtog rtsa bral du shes par bya/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ci skyes kyang ma zhen par bya'o// gnyis pa brtan pa thob par bya ba ni/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa thams cad rgyun bsring*/ dar la drag par bsgom/

'gal rkyen dang yang yang sprad/ gsum pa gegs bsal ba la gsum/ lus kyi gegs na tsha/ khams kyi gegs gnas pa rtsa/ g.yo ba rlung*/ bkod pa byang chub sems kyi gegs kyi gtso bor rlung sbyor la gnad du bsnun/ so so'i skabs bstun bcos/ dmigs pa'i gegs 'byams pa ste yul la 'thor ba la/ sna bug g.yon tu sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ gsal/ rlung gyen du drangs pas rkyang ma nas zhugs dbu mar thim par bsgom/ 'dus pa ni/ zhe sdang can dgra la 'dus pa/ gdung sems can gnyen la/ 'dod pa can nor la/ dad pa can chos la 'dus pa rnams la ro stod mdun rgyab bug pa mang po bsgom/ ha drag tu brjod cing rlung phyir la 'don/ ldong pa ni skyon yon gang yang med pa ste gdams zhan pa'am rtsol ba stod pa'i skyon no// 'di ni phyag rgya chen po'i bogs 'don/ lam thams cad kyi rming rdo/ grub thob thams cad 'di las byon pa'o/ ༈ /gsum pa gsang spyod de thub la bzhi/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa/ rig pa brtul zhugs/ phyogs las rnam rgyal (232)gyi spyod pa'o// dang po ni/ rang gnas su phyag chen gyi sgom pa la gding thob nas rkyen gang la'ang bsre nus pa bya/ gnyis pa gsang spyod nyams su blang ba'i dgos pa ni/ nyams len gyi bogs thon/ mi mthun pa grogs su 'char/ bar chad dngos grub tu 'gyur/ rka ma thag chu nang gcod pa'o// gsang spyod nus pa'i gang zag bdag 'dzin blos thang*/ nyams len snying khams che/ snang srid sgyu mar shes pa'o// des kyang 'gal rkyen bar chad byung dus ro snyoms nus shing*/ de'ang stong nyid snying rje'i grogs su 'gro nges pa zhig dgos/ de lta bus sngon 'gro lha 'dre ma bslong ba slong bar byed pa/ dngos gzhi bslangs pa non par byed pa/ mjug tu non pa dbang du sdud pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas dur khrod sogs gnyan sar/ dus mtshan mor song ste nub dang por bdag 'dzin blos btang nas na dga' 'chi skyid kyi snying khams bskyed/

gnyis par/ bla ma'i bka' sgrub phyir 'ong ba la mthor btang dmar btang bla ma mkhyen snyam pas lus la chags zhen spu tsam med par lha 'dre la btang*/ gsum par phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag /'khor 'das sems can phu thag bcad/ 'jigs mkhan gyi ngo bor brtags la nyal bas slong dang cho 'phrul 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa las/ nub bzhi par spros bcas kyi spyod pa ni/ snying rje dang sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin ma bral bas/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs stong gsum khengs pa'i thugs kar bla ma ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du khro bo khro mos khengs pa'i sku las me 'bar ba/ snang srid thams cad la nyam nga med par bsgom/ phaṭa brjod pas ba spu'i khro chung la me stag 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad thul thul tshig par bsam/ 'khor 'das sems las logs na (233)med cing chos sku blo 'das su thag chod pa'i lta dgongs kyi gding tshad ldan pa'i zhe sdang lam byed kyis gnyan sar 'gro// spros med la bzhi/ rang gzhan 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur stong pa lta ba bden 'dzin dang bral ba/ 'jigs skrag sogs rtog pa ci byung yang stong nyid du bzhag pa sgom pa yid la mi byed pa/ chos brgyad bde sdug bdud kyi bar chad lha'i dngos grub ci byung yang blang dor med par spyod pa ro snyoms la bzang ngan gang la yang re dogs med pa 'bras bu re dogs kyi g.yang sa chod pa ste gnyan sar slebs nas gnyid mi khro ba'i bar 'dod chags lam du byed pa'o// shin tu spros med la'ang bzhi/ yul gang la dngos po ci ster yang yul lha zas bdud rtsir sgom pa phyi'i tshogs/ rang lus lha la zas bdud rtsis mchod par bsam pa nang gi tshogs/ snying nas rang sems rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par don/ gri gug gis thod pa bregs/ brang kha phyes nas don snying rnam lnga blugs 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir brlabs la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bul/

mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad yi dam gyi rnam par byon/ phyag na thod pa re re thogs pa'i nang du rang lus dum bu dpag med gtubs pa bza' btung du gyur pa la longs spyad pas zag med kyi bde ba dang ldan par bsgom/ mdor na sgo gsum la bdag 'dzin med par 'khor 'das thams cad la khyab par btang ba gsang ba'i tshogs/ chos sku spros bral gyi ngang du nyal nas gnyid 'od gsal du khyer ba de kho na nyid kyi tshogs 'khor te gti mug lam du byed pa'o// nub lnga pa'i nyams len la/ phyi'i 'gal rkyen/ nang gi lus ngag yid gsum thams cad stong par bsgom la dang por lha 'dre'i rtog pa gzhom/ re ba spang*/ dogs pa blang*/ (234)ci 'ong ba shog snyam pas bar du blo bsgom gyis ro snyoms bya/ dge ba des gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob bar shog cig pa'i smon lam gdab cing tha ma snying rje'i rjes su bzung*/ de re re la'ang dus ring po// thung ngu dang*/ thad sor nyams su len pa'i tshul rgyas par 'byung ngo*// nub drug par skyabs sems bya/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhi bar bsgoms la 'jam pos 'gro/ ma gnyid bar du phyi'i lha 'dre'i byung gnas 'gro gsum dbyibs kha dog gi ngo bo rtsad bcad la gang du'ang ma grub par stong nyid du shes pas phyi 'jigs yul gyi lha 'dre dos bzung*/ gnyid du 'gro khar 'jigs pa'i mkhan po rtsad bcad pas dngos mtshan du grub pa rdul tsam med par nang 'jigs mkhan sems nyid rtsad bdar bcad/ rmi lam du ltas dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba'i dus sad pa'i tshe rang bzhin ma grub pa gcod byed gnod pa rang sems gsum gcig tu bsres la stong nyid du bzhag la 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul stong nyid du gzhil lo// gsum pa ni/ nang dug gsum gyi phyi gdon gsum bslangs nas nad gsum bslab na/ cis kyang dgos pa med/ gang 'ong bar shog ces pa'i drag sngags bzlas nas tshe 'di'i 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad/

rgyu 'bras la 'dzem/ yengs med kyi brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su blangs na gdon gsum dbang 'gyur ro// gsum pa rig brtul gyi spyad pa spyod pa po ni/ bskyed rim la rtags thon/ rdzogs rim la brtan pa thob/ gsang spyod mthar phyin pas so// dus mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob/ bla ma dang lhas lung bstan pa'i dus su'o// gnas grong khyer tshong dus dmangs dang gdol pa'i gnas su bya/ zas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gang rnyed za/ gos ro ras dang dman gos gyon/ rgyan rus rgyan nam ci snyed btags/ grogs chags (235)lam pa mtshan ldan gyi rig ma/ grol lam pa rang rig bde ba'i nyams dang 'grogs spyod lam glu gar bro rtsed smyo spyod sna tshogs byas pas 'bar sha skur 'debs rdeg rgyung byung ba'i tshe rabs kyis rdzu 'phrul bstan nas gzhan gyis ma dad ba bzlog /'bring gis chags sdang dgag sgrub gnyis med phyag rgya chen po ro snyoms pa/ thams 'gal rkyen la skyon du mi lta bar lam du khyer na bogs thon pa'o// bod du rgyud nas bshad pa'i spyod pa spyad nus pa med pas de'i tshab tu phyogs med kyi ldom bu byed cing ro snyoms kyi spyod pa skyong ba yin no// bzhi ba phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ spyod pa snga ma gsum gyis rim par gding thob/ gzugs med gzugs can la brten nas ro snyoms de rnams mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu 'khor ba ngan song bdud dang 'gal rkyen bar chad kyi phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por 'gyur ro/ ༈ /bzhi pa nad gdon 'khrugs thub la gsum/ dgos pa/ ngos 'dzin/ nad 'dod thabs so// dang po ni/ ri khrod sman dpyad mi 'dzom pa'i sa dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab byar mi 'gal ba dang*/ 'jig rten phal pa las khyad par 'phags pa dang*/ rkyen ngan la 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ bar do'i shes pa nyams 'og tu tshud pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la gsum/

phyi gnod byed gdon gyi nad la rmi lam dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyams 'khrugs pa la brtag /bar 'byung ba 'dus pa'i nad la/ lus ngag yid gsum/ rlung mkhris bad kan/ sa chu me rlung*/ nyon mongs dug gsum gyi nad rnams las/ lus la 'them 'chus lhag dang gsum// ngag la log 'tshubs stor dang gsum// sems la 'byams 'dus srong dang gsum/ dgu po'i 'phrang la ma rdug na// sgom skyon 'byung bar mi (236)'gyur ro// zhes pa rnams dang*/ gzhan las 'byung ba ltar nyes pa gsum sogs ngos bzung*/ nad rnam par rtog pa'i nad ni/ rnam rtog la nad dang gdon du bzung ba'o// gsum pa la gsum/ thun mong spyi/ bye brag so so'i nad 'don/ mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po la gsum/ dang po thabs la mkhas pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig /bar du gdams pa zab mo'i gnad kyis 'don/ tha ma zlog sgom byas la lta thog tu bsgyur ba'o// dang po ni/ lus longs spyod mchod sbyin du btang nas tshogs bsags/ bshags pa yig brgya tshogs 'khor sogs kyi sgrib pa sbyang*/ bla ma dkon mchog la mos gus drag pos gsol 'debs bya/ gnyis pa ni/ blo rab kyis lta bas 'don te/ phyag rgya chen po'i gsal 'debs/ byams dang snying rje'i bogs 'don/ las kyi sgrib pa'i sgrib sbyong du bstan la so so'i lam khyer spyi dang mthun/ blo 'bring sgom pas 'don te/ stong par sgom pa/ bla mar sgom pa/ bde bar sgom pa gsum las dang po ni/ gang du na ba'i sa nas bug pa lcags tshag gi mig lta bu grangs mang ba nas nad thams cad dung rlang sngo dmar gyi rnam pa dang*/ rten sha khrag la sogs pa'ang phyir la shad kyis thon par bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ 'og rkang mthil sogs ma yin pa'i nad dmigs der shel gyi gzhal yas khang du bla ma sangs rgyas sman bla'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od 'phros/ nad thams cad phyir bdas/ bla ma 'od zhu na sar thim pas bde sang song bar bsgom/

gsum pa ni/ na sa der bde mchog yab yum tshon gang par gsal ba la bla ma yi dam thams cad byon nas thim/ yab yum snyom 'jug mdzad pa'i byang sems dkar dmar gyis gang*/ nad dang de'i rgyu/ na mkhan thams cad bde ba'i ngo bor phril gyis song bar bsam (237)la bde stong zag med kyi ngang du lhod/ blo thams spyod pas 'don pa la gsum/ dkar mngar sha chang spang*/ lto bcag la de chu dang*/ phye thug rdor med bsten/ me nyir mi sdod/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gi las mi bya/ nyin gnyid mi log /dus bzhi dang mthun pa sogs spyod lam gzab/ mgo dang mgrin pa/ ro stod dpung ba/ lto ba rked pa rnams lhan cig /rkang pa gnyis so sor byas te sprugs pa dang*/ bskor ba dang*/ gcu ba dang*/ bkan pa dang*/ sprugs par bya'o// gnyis pa gdams pa zab mo'i gnad mdor bsdus 'og tu 'byung*/ gsum pa zlog sgom ni/ phan bde dang gnod pa de gnyis ka las log nas bdag 'dzin blos btang la ci 'ong shog snyam pa'i mtha' med rlung khyer du btang ngo*// gnyis pa bye brag so so'i nad 'don pa la gsum/ phyi gnod byed gdon gyi nad gsang spyod dang ro snyoms ltar nyams su blang*/ bar 'byung ba 'dus pa'i nad 'don pa la gsum/ dang po lus ngag yid gsum gyi nad 'don pa ni/ lus nad 'them pa la rma'i nang du bla ma bsgom/ bla ma'i gsang ba nas thig le babs bas/ rma'i nang bde 'phol gyis song bar bsgom/ de nas bla mar rang yang bdud rtsir zhu nas rma'i nang du thim pas/ sngar bas kyang bde ba chen por bsgom mo// mchus pa la gang du mchus pa der sad kyis brtsad bar bsgom pas/ rtsa dbugs rag dung gi rkang lta bu seng nge 'dug ba'i nang na mar la khrag dang chu ser dang*/ nad thams cad rlung gi brdas nas si ri ri 'gro bar bsam mo// lhag par gang du skrang pa der/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sen mo tsam zhig gi steng na me bya sgong tsam zhig bsgoms la/

nad de so so khol bar bsam/ de nas tshig par bsgom/ tha ma me ru 'bar bar bsgom mo// ngag gi nad gsum (238)las lag pa las/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga gang log kyang sngon la zhun chen gyi bku mnye bya/ de nas khu tshur gyis ran par brdung*/ zas bcud can btang*/ na sar thig le a ru ra'i snying po tsam cig bsgoms la/ bde bas khengs par bsgom mo// yan lag gi rlung lnga log pa la gang log pa'i sa der/ bug pa zang thal bsgoms la/ nad thams cad rlung gis bdas nas stong sing par bsgom/ 'tshub pa la/ gang du 'tshub kyang spyi bo'i rgya mthong 'phang lo tsam cig kha phye la de nas yar nad thams cad khang chung du bas khengs pa la skar khung kha phye ba bzhin sngo phyur gyis song bar bsgom zhing*/ rlung phyir la drag tu 'bud do// gtong ba la dmigs pa bcun la rtsol ba skyed cing bsgom mo// sems kyi nad gsum las// 'byams la sems nyid rnam rtog gi ngo bo de/ sna sgo g.yon par hūm̐ sngon po nas tsam zhig bsgom la/ rlung sna nas rngubs te mnan pas/ hūm̐ de rtsa rkyang ma'i nang na mar chu'i sna la ril ma brdas pa bzhin du song la/ dbu ma'i nang du thim gyis song nas/ dbu ma'i rtsa sna kha zum pas rig pa de nag thum rtser song bar bsgom mo// 'dus pa la rtog pa gzhan du spo// sems yengs su gzhug /snying dang brang la bug ba phyogs bzhi ru dbus dang lngar bsgoms la de nas phar 'byung ba lnga'i rlung dang nad bldongs nas sngo bun song bar bsgom/ ha bsgrangs rngams rings gdon/ snying gar bla ma bsgom/ bla ma zhu nas thim pas nyams dga' yar rtser song bar bsgom mo/ kho'i rna bar sdug bsngal skye ba dang*/ sems khral 'ong ba dang*/ mi snyan pa'i gtam mi sgrog /bred sngangs skye bo'i spyod pa mi bya/ lteng ba la rig pa dpang bstod/ rgya mtsho chen po'i dkyil na gangs ri chen po gcig bsgom/ de'i steng na rang 'dug par bsgom/

skabs su phaṭa drag po (239)gdab/ dus rgyun du rig pa la ngar btags la hu re bya'o// gsum pa mjug sdud pa ni/ nad gdon gang la'ang gdams ngag tshig po nyams su blang bar bya ste/ gzhi lta ba'i go cha/ lam bla ma'i mos gus// dmigs pa rnon po'i mtshon cha/ thabs la mkhas pa'i rten 'brel lo// dang po ni re dogs med pa lta ba'i thog tu blo thag bcad/ nad la nad du mi 'dzin/ nad na bdag 'dzin bor/ gnyis pa ni/ nad sos rung ma sos rung bla ma mkhyen/ tshig dang po 'gus la blo gtad/ gsum pa ni/ dmigs pa gsal rung mi gsal rung yengs med phur tshugs su bsgom/ bzhi pa ni/ tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong ci nus 'bad/ spyod lam la gzab bo// spyir nad gdon thams cad lta ba la rgyab gtad/ blo bla ma la bkal/ tshogs gsog gi dpung bskyed/ rno dmigs pas 'don/ snying rje'i ngang nas las su bsgom/ mthar thug zlog sgom gyi thog tu bsgyur ba bcas drug po de'i gnad kyis zin na/ shi rung gson rung blo bde'i gding rnyed pa'o/ ༈ /lnga pa gnyen po rkyen thub la/ spyir bka' mdo rgyud bla ma'i gdams ngag thams cad rkyen thub pa kho na'i thog tu 'dril dgos/ bye brag tu bstan pa la gsum/ rkyen la gnyen po btang ba/ gnyen po ma thengs pa'i skyon/ thengs pa'i yon tan no// dang po la gsum/ rkyen ngos bzung ba/ gnyen po btang ba'i dus/ gtong ba'i thabs so// dang po gsum/ ngan pa'i rkyen dug lnga sdangs pa rgyu'i rkyen dang*/ des skyed pa'i na tsha sdug bsngal byung ba'i chos la blo ma khel nas mo gto sman dpyad la re ba'o// thun mong rkyen/ dge ba la chog shes pa dang*/ bslab gsum sogs skyo zhing sun pa'o// bzang po'i rkyen/ rang rgyud la yon tan skyes pa dang gzhan (240)gyis bstod bsngags la sogs pa byung ba'i tshe nga rgyal dang phrag dog skyes pa'o// gnyis pa btang ba'i dus ni/ 'das pa'i rkyen la gnyen po phyis snyegs su btang ste/

sngar byas kyi las la thams cad la 'gyod pa'i sems kyis dran par byas rus pa'i gting nas bshags pa byas te ra mda' byed pa'o// ma 'ongs pa'i rkyen sngon bsu ru btang ste/ nyon mongs dang 'gal rkyen gyi mi gnod pa'i go cha bsgo'o// so kha bsrung ba'i zon dang byar byed pa lta bu'o// de lta'i rkyen la 'phrad 'dzom bya ste/ chags sdang dang nyon mongs pa skyes tshad chu la ral gri rgyab pa'am/ rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa lta bu rjes med la gtong ba ste/ g.yul du zhugs nas lag 'phrad pa lta bu ste/ lam du ci long dang rang grol la btang ba'o// gsum pa gtong ba'i thabs ni/ rab lta bas stong nyid du bsgom/ 'bring bsgom pas lha skur bsgom/ tha ma spyod pas snying rjer bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga de pha rol po'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnas sam/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la gnas sam/ nyon mongs pa rang gi ngo bo dbyibs dang kha dog tu grub pa 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ 'dod chags mkhan dang chags yul ma grub pa med/ spros bral stong pa'am/ skye med blo 'das kyi ngang du bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ chags sdang skyes pa'i dus na rab lha sku dang bla mar bsgyur/ 'bring pha dang ma ru bsgyur/ tha ma grogs mdza' bshes ma nor gces par bsgyur/ 'dod chags mos gus dang byams par bsgyur/ zhe sdang snying rje dang phan sems su bsgyur la/ nga rgyal gzhan gyi yon tan du bsgom/ phrag dog rang gi rkyen du bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs pa rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe na rang la snying rje bsgom/ bstan pa'i sgor nyan thos kyi sdom pa blangs nas gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spangs dgos pa dang*/ (241)byang sdom blangs nas sems can thams cad la pha ma'i 'du shes bsgom dgos pa las/ sems chags sdang dang ma bral ba snying re rje/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg bar dbang bskur nas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/

nad bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mor bsgom dgos pa la/ bsam pa zhe sdang dang ma bral bar 'dug pa snying re rje/ bla mas phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad nas/ 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad skye med spros bral du bsgom dgos pa la da rung dngos po dang mtshan ma bzung nas/ sems chags sdang dang ma bral bar 'dug pa snying re rje snyam pa byas la ji srid nyon mongs pa de ma zad kyi bar du/ ci chom gyi thabs la 'bad do// gnyis pa gnyen po ma thengs pa'i skyon ni/ gnas skabs su yon tan rgyud la mi skye zhing mthar thug ngan 'gro'i rgyur 'gyur ro// gsum pa thengs pa'i yon tan ni/ gnas skabs phyi nang gi yon tan dang lam gyi mngon rtogs gong du 'phel/ mthar thug sku bzhi lnga'i bdag nyid du sangs rgyas nas gzhan don gyi phrin las mkha' khyab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i khrid tshul khyad par can 'di'ang rgyun shin tu dkon pa/ snang bas dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad bas kun nas bslangs te/ jo nang rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog gi gsung rab las 'byung ba nyid rtsa bar bzung*/ yig rnying gi bshad don bsgril ba'i gsal byed kyis brgyan te karma dag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos shrī de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// (242)
